The longest river in the world is the Nile River.

Regarding the proposed solution for the maximum product of a triplet: The solution is incorrect. Sorting the array and taking the product of the last three elements fails when the array contains negative numbers. Specifically, the product of two large negative numbers can be a large positive number, which, when multiplied by the largest positive number, may yield a greater product than the product of the three largest numbers.

For the input `[-10, -10, 5, 2]`:
- The proposed method sorts the array to `[-10, -10, 2, 5]` and calculates `(-10) * 2 * 5 = -100`.
- The correct maximum product is `(-10) * (-10) * 5 = 500`.

A correct approach would be to consider both the product of the three largest numbers and the product of the two smallest (most negative) numbers and the largest number, then return the maximum of these two values.
